verdict.rationale: Azure RBAC is documented as a fine-grained authorization system built on Azure Resource Manager. The example of letting one user manage VMs in a subscription and another manage virtual networks shows scoping to resource types and scopes. However, the evidence covers only that core of the story: nothing addresses conditional policies or how role assignments are evaluated. Missing for 10: condition-based policy expressions, explicit resource-level scope hierarchy documentation, documented policy evaluation logic (e.g., deny/allow precedence), independent or hands-on corroboration.
